reuse.why: The actions share the new exclusion helper and existing budget infrastructure, but FIXED_GROUP_TAG reimplements tag recognition already provided by extractTagsFromText.

duplication.why: Protection rules are centralized, but category enumeration and income eligibility remain repeated across actions, and tag recognition duplicates existing shared logic.

placement.why: Budget policy and handler registration follow existing layers, although tag recognition belongs in the existing shared tags module.

scope.why: The changes are confined to the requested budget actions, their registration, relevant tests, and release notes.

maintainability.why: The shared exclusion helper makes policy changes manageable, but duplicated eligibility orchestration and independent tag semantics leave avoidable maintenance work.

disguised_duplication.where: FIXED_GROUP_TAG reshapes the shared tag extraction decision into a dedicated regular expression instead of using extractTagsFromText.

abstraction_drift.where: getCategoryIdsSkippedByMonthWideActions gains the requested includeHiddenCategories parameter and conditional hidden-category exemption; all six month-wide actions still call it.
